items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-06-17
items.q: So what we did, we started playing for him. Who was in the band at that time? ... Joe James, or Bikes, Albert Jackson.

ctx.x: Sure. And did you know that tune, Confessing, from the Lister record? What? Confessing, did you know that from Lister's record?

I don't believe, no. No, I confess, no. I learned from somebody. I mean Walsh, Edmund Walsh, and start playing that. Oh, yeah. Yeah, Edmund Walsh, yeah. He started playing it. Yeah, yeah. He started playing it. Yeah, Walsh. He used to sing it, you know. Yeah, you learned it from him. But I'll tell you what, after we had the band up and everything, and I played at the Monroe Rouge, you see what? We was playing, Larkport, racing, Larkport, Gold Medal, all the way down to Grand Island, Tibido, Bomo, Baton Rouge, all…
Who did you have in the band?

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: Yeah we had piano, Joe James, the same piano player.

ctx.x: Most people don't say those things.

No, they ain't got nothing. I'm the only one got them pictures. So, alright. Like, you take like the uniforms. We used to wear a uniform, we had a jacket, a blue jacket, with a dark lapel, you know what I mean? And, blue pants with stripes. And, you know what I mean? None of them fellas don't have the jacket and the pants. I'm still got them. You stayed here? And that been years ago. I even got them white pants we used to wear. Even got that. See? You know what? Sometimes boys see me, we say, man, what? See, they…
Where you live in? He lives out on, oh near Roman Street.
